name: a-crosshatch-wide-autumn
idea: Beat A, 1919. A wide full-figure shot from straight on at bench height, in dense fine-line pen crosshatching on off-white newsprint, black ink only. The bench sits under a bare autumn plane tree with fallen leaves; the rich man takes up two-thirds of it, enormous waistcoat stretched over his belly, top hat, spats, one gloved hand flicking outward in dismissal while he looks away. The soldier, thin, in a worn greatcoat with an empty trouser leg pinned up and a crutch against the bench, is squeezed onto the last third and looks at him. Top quarter of the frame is empty pale sky for the caption.

name: a-grease-crayon-low-angle
idea: Beat A, 1919. Low angle from the gravel path, looking up so the rich man looms like a monument against a grey overcast sky, drawn in heavy black grease crayon with soft broken edges and a thin ink wash, the radical-magazine look rather than fine pen. His palm is raised flat toward the soldier, a stop gesture, cigar in the other hand. The soldier is in the lower corner, small, crutch across his knees, face half in shadow. Rough crayon grain carries all the tone; the bottom fifth is open path for the caption.

name: a-two-colour-overhead
idea: Beat A, 1919. A high overhead view looking down on the bench from a lamp post, like a printed magazine plate in black ink plus one flat spot colour, brick red, used only on the rich man's waistcoat, which is patterned with tiny dollar signs. The bench, the path and the long winter shadows make a strong diagonal; the soldier's crutch and single boot cast their own shadow. The rich man's hand waves away from the soldier. Off-white paper margin across the top for the caption.

name: b-crosshatch-hospital-dusk
idea: Beat B, today. The same pen-and-ink crosshatch technique and the same bench design, but the park is modern: a bin, a phone-charging lamp post, a hospital tower block behind the trees at dusk with lit windows drawn as small white rectangles in the black hatching. The rich man is identical to 1919, top hat, waistcoat, spats, sitting exactly as before and flicking the same gloved hand away. Beside him a nurse in scrubs and a lanyard, trainers, a paper coffee cup, eyes shut with exhaustion. Top quarter of sky left clear for the caption.

name: b-crayon-closeup-hands
idea: Beat B, today. A tight medium close-up on the two of them from the waist up, in black grease crayon and ink wash, framed so the rich man's dismissive raised hand sits in the middle of the picture, sharp, while the nurse's face behind it is softer. She is mid-sentence, a hand on her chest, hospital ID badge on her scrubs; he does not even turn his head, chin up under the top hat. Strong side light from the left, deep crayon blacks on the right. Plain wall of hedge at the bottom for the caption.

name: b-laid-paper-rain
idea: Beat B, today. A medium-wide shot in the rain, drawn with pen line over strongly textured laid paper so the grey tone comes from the paper grain and fine diagonal rain strokes, not wash. The rich man sits dry under a big black umbrella he holds only over himself, top hat intact, waving the nurse off; she sits in the rain in scrubs and a thin cardigan, a tote bag on her lap. Puddles and a modern bus shelter behind. Open sky band above for the caption.

name: c-split-diptych
idea: Beat C, the button. One portrait frame split horizontally by a thin drawn panel border: the top panel is the 1919 bench with the soldier, the bottom panel the modern bench with the nurse, both in matching pen crosshatch, the rich man in exactly the same pose, angle and size in both, so he lines up like a stamp. The two companions differ completely; he does not differ at all. A clear white gutter strip between the panels holds the caption.

name: c-portrait-straight-to-camera
idea: Beat C, the button. The rich man alone on the bench, centred, full figure, looking straight out at the viewer with a small satisfied smile, drawn as a clean character-reference plate in fine pen and crosshatch on off-white paper. Both seats beside him are empty, with only a dropped crutch on one side and a dropped hospital lanyard on the other. Even, flat light, plain background so he reads as the reference for every later frame. Generous blank space above his hat for the caption.

name: c-red-spot-repeated-benches
idea: Beat C, the button. A deep receding view down a long park path lined with identical benches, black ink and grease crayon with a single red spot colour; on every bench into the distance sits the same rich man in the same pose, top hat and red dollar-sign waistcoat, while the people beside him change from bench to bench across the years (a soldier, a factory girl, a miner, a nurse). The nearest bench is large in the foreground, the rest shrink to the vanishing point. Pale sky at the top for the caption.
